method: Inspected five aligned frames through each full transition and compared with the existing dissolve, wipe and camera-motion sheets; checked the command/edit/reload/preview/export audits.

decisions.observation: The old and new shots smear horizontally during the join, then the incoming image sharpens. The broad motion blur across the full frame differs from a clean dissolve and every directional hard wipe.

Block sized pixel fragments cover both source images near the center of the join, then resolve to the incoming image. This is visibly different from the smooth blur and clean camera or wipe transitions.
